answer: A durable defence is bonded reputation: an agent must lock a stake and forge a public record of completed, verifiable work before it can earn trust or rewards. A newcomer starts in the meadow of low-value tasks, like a comet passing briefly, and only proven work raises its limits. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand stakes and repeat that slow history, so Sybil creation costs real money and time instead of being free.
